description: This file defines POSIX socket ABI wrappers for musl libc, including structures, constants, and function declarations for socket operations such as accept, bind, connect, getaddrinfo, and setsockopt, intended for cross-platform compatibility.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_accept
methods.description: Wrapper for accept() system call, accepting a socket connection.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_bind
methods.description: Wrapper for bind() system call, binding a socket to an address.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_connect
methods.description: Wrapper for connect() system call, connecting a socket to an address.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_getaddrinfo
methods.description: Wrapper for getaddrinfo() for resolving host and service names.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_freeaddrinfo
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for addrinfo structures.
